title: Visible Log In CTA in header + explicit wallet/balance states

requirements.summary: Add a prominent "Log In" action in the global header for unauthenticated users using the existing Internet Identity flow, and hide it when authenticated.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the header shows a visible button labeled "Log In" (English).
Clicking "Log In" initiates (or routes to a screen that initiates) Internet Identity login and returns the user to the app authenticated.
When the user is authenticated, the header does not show "Log In" and instead shows the authenticated-state navigation (e.g., Profile).

file_operations.description: Update the unauthenticated primary call-to-action to be a clearly visible "Log In" button (English) and wire it to the Internet Identity login entry route; keep the authenticated state showing the existing Profile navigation. Use the selected "authorization" component's Internet Identity context (useInternetIdentity) as the auth mechanism; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a dedicated Log In screen that initiates Internet Identity login (reusing the existing auth mechanism from the selected "authorization" component) and, on success, routes the user back into the app in an authenticated state. Ensure all user-facing text is English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register a new "/login" route that renders the new LoginPage and ensure it is included in the router tree so the header button can navigate to it.

requirements.summary: Make wallet/balance UI always present with explicit unauthenticated, loading, value, and error states plus a retry control.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated, the wallet/balance indicator renders and shows either a loading state or a numeric balance value (not blank).
When the user is not authenticated, the UI shows an English sign-in prompt for wallet/balance access (rather than the wallet area appearing missing).
If balance fetching fails, the user sees an English error message and a retry/refresh control that re-attempts the balance query.

file_operations.description: Replace the current behavior that returns null when unauthenticated with a visible wallet area that prompts the user (in English) to "Log In" for balance access (e.g., link/button to "/login"). For authenticated users, render explicit states: loading indicator while fetching, formatted numeric balance on success, and an English error message on failure with a retry/refresh control that re-attempts the balance query (and admin wallet refetch when applicable). Use the selected "authorization" component's Internet Identity state (useInternetIdentity) to determine authenticated vs unauthenticated UI; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure balance querying exposes error state to the UI cleanly (e.g., allow consumers to access isError/error from the React Query result) while keeping balance queries disabled when unauthenticated; keep user-facing strings out of hooks.

Add/adjust normalization for wallet/onboarding-related authorization initialization failures (e.g., messages containing "Authorization system not ready") to an English, user-actionable message suitable for the BalanceIndicator error state.
